# TDrive v3.1.8

This release makes Android folder import safe to repeat. Importing a folder
again no longer uploads files that are already on the drive, existing folders
are reused instead of creating `Folder (1)` copies, and failed files are listed
in full so you can retry them. v3.1.8 also includes everything planned for 3.1.7 (3.1.7 was never published). Bản phát hành này giúp việc nhập thư mục trên
Android an toàn khi làm lại nhiều lần. Nhập lại một thư mục sẽ không tải lên
những tệp đã có trên drive, các thư mục đã có sẽ được dùng lại thay vì tạo
`Folder (1)`, và các tệp lỗi được liệt kê đầy đủ để bạn thử lại.

## Highlights

- Android folder import no longer uploads files that are already on the drive.
  It checks the live drive for the same name, size and encryption setting, and
  reuses existing folders instead of creating `Folder (1)`. Running the same
  import again only uploads what is new or changed.
- Failed files are listed in full with a plain reason, with Copy list and Retry
  failed. A retry never repeats a file the drive may already hold.
- Android temporary camera files (`.pending-*` and `.trashed-*`) are ignored.
- Safer import: cancel and drive switches stop the job before it writes,
  unreadable folders are reported instead of looking empty, cloud-only files are
  explained, and leftover temporary copies are cleaned up at startup.
- The result shows uploaded, already on the drive, ignored and failed counts. If
  everything is already there, the import finishes without touching anything.
- Empty files (0 bytes) can't be stored on Telegram: folder import now skips
  them with a clear note instead of reporting a failed upload, and the failed-files
  list no longer suggests retrying them.

## Known limits

- A changed file with the same name and size is only re-uploaded if this device
  remembers its earlier modified time.
- On desktop, importing into an existing folder still creates `Name (2)`.
- Very large folders (tens of thousands of files) are not optimized yet.
- The new text is machine-translated in 18 languages.
- The Android pieces were checked with automated tests, not on a real phone
  with cloud or virtual files.
- Desktop folder import still lists an empty file as failed, with the clear reason.

## Internal

- New tests cover the import ledger, folder resolution, import policy and the
  Android import flow in the frontend.

## Downloads

| Platform | File | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Windows 10/11 (64-bit) | `TDrive-v3.1.8-windows-amd64-setup.exe` | Installer. A portable `TDrive-v3.1.8-windows-amd64.zip` is also attached. |
| macOS (Apple silicon) | `TDrive-v3.1.8-macos-arm64.zip` | Unzip and drag TDrive to Applications. |
| Linux (64-bit) | `TDrive-v3.1.8-x86_64.AppImage` | `chmod +x` it, then run it. Needs glibc 2.35 or newer. |
| Android 7.0 or newer (ARM64) | `TDrive-v3.1.8-android-arm64.apk` | Allow installs from your browser or file manager when Android asks. |
| iPhone / iPad (iOS 16 or newer) | `TDrive-v3.1.8-ios-unsigned.ipa` | Not signed. Install with TrollStore, Sideloadly or AltStore. |

## Integrity

- `checksums.txt` lists SHA-256 digests for the downloadable packages.
- `checksums.txt.sig` authenticates that manifest for the desktop updater using the embedded Ed25519 trust keys.
